hero.intro: Studio, one and two bedroom apartments in Lower Queen Anne, a short walk from Seattle Center and the Space Needle.

neighborhood.title: Queen Anne, in the heart of it
neighborhood.intro: Independent cafes, boutiques, galleries and venues, with Seattle Center at the end of the block and quick access to South Lake Union, Capitol Hill, Downtown and the waterfront.

features.title: Rooftop terrace
features.body: Skyline views, grills and seating. The whole city from your own roof.

features.title: 24-hour fitness center
features.body: Cardio, free weights and a cable machine, on site and open around the clock.

features.title: Stainless steel kitchens
features.body: Stainless appliances, dishwashers and premium finishes. Select homes add kitchen islands.

features.title: Studios to two bedrooms
features.body: A range of layouts in one building, so you can size up or down without leaving the neighborhood.

features.title: Pet friendly
features.body: Up to two pets per home, a pet wash in the building, and Seattle Center for a backyard.

features.title: Steps from Seattle Center
features.body: The Space Needle, MoPOP and Climate Pledge Arena are a short walk away.

marquee: Studio, one and two bedroom homes
